Phone 5025550118; DOB/SSN4/ZIP on request; contract FA42295071; payment "By check, mailed to my house, like I put on the claim form"; name spelled "Rachel Mercer-Lindqvist"; on request only: brother Daniel "passed away last December", sister Ellen handling her own share. She authorises whatever Ashgrove must do; she runs the lump-sum election tool herself with the figures read to her. Target, timing (now), action boundary (her share, lump sum) and authorisation (beneficiary's own tool) are explicit; simulator is passive.

### 4. Scored parameters

**(a) Default renewal rate** (Rate-Setting Worksheet: SecureRate Default Renewal Rate). Renewal date 2026-08-21. Factors and tiers:
- Measurement date (Actuarial Practice Note: Measuring the Renewal Value): owner died 2026-07-14, before the renewal date -> measured on date of death: 285023.91 x 1.0555^(327/365) = 299155.71.
- Value bands (Rate Band Table): 250000 <= 299155.71 < 300000 -> 0.20% (in place of the baseline's high band step; the band table carries the high band addition as its own 100000-250000 row).
- Persistency (Persistency Addition): expiring period began on the issue date (schedule start = issue date) and no withdrawal ever -> 0.15%.
- Whole life relationship renewal addition: WL41187340 on record (any status); premium payments in the twelve months before the renewal is recorded (2026-10-22): 2025-11-15 .. 2026-07-15 = 9 -> 0.05%.
- Rate: 4.40% + 0.20% + 0.15% + 0.05% = **0.0480**.
- Fall-back: renewal value on renewal date 285023.91 x 1.0555^(365/365) = 300842.74 >= 100000 -> 4.40% + 0.15% = **0.0455**.

**(b) Death benefit valuation interest** (Claims Valuation Memorandum). After (a) the record shows guaranteed rate 0.0480 and schedule start 2026-08-21.
- Valuation date (Valuation Date ...: Whole Life Certificates and Late Claims): a certified certificate for the owner was received on the Whole Life death claim (received 2026-08-27) before this contract's claim (2026-09-09) -> **2026-08-27**. (Reading: the whole life claim record carries `death_certificate_received: True` and its `received_date`; no separate certificate date exists, so the certificate receipt date is read as that claim's received date.)
- Rates across guarantee period end: renewal date 2026-08-21 lies after the latest credit 2025-08-21 and before 2026-08-27; valuation date is 6 days after the renewal date (within 30) -> two parts: 365 days at the expiring rate 5.55% (rate on the latest credit entry), 6 days at the current guaranteed rate 4.80%.
- Additions to each rate: value band (contract value at latest credit 285023.91, 250000-299999.99) +0.05%; age and duration (age 80 at death, 2 whole years held from 2023-08-21) +0.10%; income annuity relationship (IA41520936 held, 9 installments 2025-11-01 .. 2026-07-01 in the twelve months before the credit on 2026-10-22) +0.05%. Total +0.20% -> 5.75% and 5.00%.
- Result: 285023.91 x (1.0575^(365/365) x 1.05^(6/365) − 1) = 16630.7139 -> **16630.71**, valuation_date 2026-08-27. Contract value afterwards 301654.62.
- Fall-back: through claim receipt 2026-09-09 (384 days) at the record rate 4.80%: **14411.03** (at the unrenewed 5.55%: 16665.90).

**(c) Claimant's share and death claim interest** (Claims Computation Sheet: Beneficiary Share and Death Claim Interest).
- Death benefit 301654.62. Daniel J. Mercer, a named primary, died 2025-12-03 before the owner, shown by an Ashgrove death claim on a policy insuring him (term LT41968205) -> Rachel's percent 50/(100−30) x 100 = 71.4286%. Share = 301654.62 x 50/70 = 215467.5857 -> **215467.59**.
- Interest factors: start date (State Variation Note: Start): VA not CA/NY/NJ; claim received 2026-09-09 is 13 days after valuation date (>10) -> runs from 2026-09-09. Days by payment method: claim shows `check` -> +3 days. Days 2026-09-09 -> 2026-10-22 = 43 + 3 = 46. Divisor: VA -> 360. Base rate (Delayed Payments table): 56 days from valuation date to payment (>45) -> 5%. Late settlement addition: 36 days from approval 2026-09-16 (>30), VA (not FL/GA/TX) -> +1%. Whole life coordination: WL death benefit disbursed 2026-09-02, 50 days before payment (>30) -> +0.50%. Rate 6.50%.
- Interest = 215467.59 x 0.065 x 46/360 = 1789.5838 -> **1789.58**.
- Fall-back: 3.5% x 56 days / 365 on the same share = **1157.03** (and the share without the predeceased reallocation: 150827.31).

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

Root: lump-sum settlement of the beneficiary's share (her own write).
- Hop 1 (state-derived). Lump-Sum Settlement standard, "Waiting state": "A beneficiary's death benefit share is not paid until the contract carries the valuation interest credited through the valuation date of the death benefit." Records: latest interest credit is the 2025-08-21 anniversary credit (period end 2025-08-20); nothing closes on a valuation date. Searching "valuation interest" / "valuation date of the death benefit" leads to "Claims Standard: Valuation Interest on the Death Benefit": "When an owner's death is on file, the contract's death benefit is valued by crediting the death benefit valuation interest, dated the day it is credited and closing on the valuation date, to the contract value." That is the write.
- Hop 2 (state-derived). Valuation Interest standard, "Waiting state": "The death benefit valuation interest is fixed only after the contract carries its renewed guaranteed rate for every guarantee period that ended before the valuation date." Records: guarantee period end 2026-08-20, earlier than either candidate valuation date; record still shows the 0.0555 rate and schedule start 2023-08-21, i.e. no renewed rate. Searching "renewed guaranteed rate" / "guarantee period ended" leads to "Service Standard: Default Renewal of SecureRate Guarantee Periods": "A SecureRate contract whose guarantee period has ended without a renewal election renews by default ... and the renewal is recorded with the default renewal rate", with the table "Guaranteed rate | The default renewal rate". That is the write. No renewal election on file.
- The renewal standard states no waiting state -> leaf.
- Order: record default renewal -> credit valuation interest -> beneficiary's lump-sum election. No hop pre-solved: no document names another problem's tool, a route or a chain.

### Two-way counter-proof

- "Do only what she asked" (compute the share at once and hand over the settlement tool): excluded by the settlement waiting state and the record showing no valuation-interest credit; crediting valuation interest at once is excluded by the valuation waiting state plus the record showing the guarantee period ended 2026-08-20 with no renewed rate. Weight also shows in the figures: before renewal the schedule start is 2023-08-21, so the "two parts" rule of the rates-across-period-end note cannot trigger and the interest would differ.
- Valuation date alternatives (claim receipt 2026-09-09; date of death + 365): closed by rule 1 of the valuation-date document using the whole life claim record.
- Share alternatives (50% straight): closed by the computation sheet's predeceased-primary clause and the term policy death claim on Daniel J. Mercer.
- Interest start alternatives: closed by the start-date matrix row "Any other state | More than 10 days after | The date the death claim was received".
- Base-rate combination: delayed-payment table supplies "the claim interest base rate"; the late settlement and whole life coordination additions are each "made to the claim interest base rate".
- Renewal band reading: the band table's own 100000-250000 row is the high band addition, so the band addition stands in place of the baseline's high band step (reading choice, recorded).

### Findability of each factor from record words

Measurement date from the death claim's `owner_date_of_death` (title "Measuring the Renewal Value"); bands from the measured value; persistency from schedule start = issue date and absence of withdrawals; whole life additions from WL41187340 (`claim_paid`, premiums, `whole_death_benefit_disbursed`, death claim with certificate) via titles naming "Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance"; income annuity addition from IA41520936 (`completed`, installments) via a title naming "Ashgrove Income Annuities"; VA-state notes from `issue_state: VA` ("State Variation Note" titles); payment-method days from `disbursement_method: check`; delayed and late-settlement factors from dates on the claim. Predeceased primary from the term policy insuring "Daniel J. Mercer" (Term product records). No computation document hints that a variation exists.
